instruction:
Parse this Docker json-file log into JSON with message, stream and time (drop the trailing newline):
{"log": "request handled\n", "stream": "stdout", "time": "2023-10-12T14:05:07.123456789Z"}

Parse this CRI container log line into JSON with time, stream, partial flag and message:
2023-10-12T14:05:07.123456789Z stdout F GET /healthz 200

This CRI line is a partial (continuation) line. Parse it into JSON and set partial to true:
2023-10-12T14:05:08.123456789Z stderr P connecting to backend 10.0.0.

Parse this prefixed pod log line into JSON with timestamp, pod and message:
2023-10-12T14:05:09Z [api-7d9f-abc12] INFO listening on :8080

Parse this kubelet klog line into JSON with level, pid, source, message, pod and containerID:
I1012 14:05:11.123456   1234 kubelet.go:123] "Container terminated" pod="default/api-1" containerID="docker://abc123"

Parse this Kubernetes event JSON into JSON with type, reason, namespace, pod and count:
{"type": "Warning", "reason": "BackOff", "object": {"kind": "Pod", "namespace": "default", "name": "api-1"}, "message": "Back-off restarting failed container", "count": 5, "firstTimestamp": "2023-10-12T14:05:12Z"}

output: ["Container api was OOM killed", "Container worker was OOM killed"]

instruction:
Parse these three application log lines from kubectl logs into a JSON array with ts, level and message:
2023-10-12T14:05:13Z INFO boot completed
2023-10-12T14:05:14Z WARN slow request took 2.5s
2023-10-12T14:05:15Z ERROR db connection lost

This CRI-O json log carries a kubernetes object. Extract pod, container and namespace as JSON:
{"log_type": "stdout", "log": "order created\n", "kubernetes": {"pod_name": "checkout-5f8d-xyz", "container_name": "app", "namespace": "shop", "pod_id": "9f2c4a1b"}}
Write a Python function that parses a Docker json-file log line and returns time, stream and the trimmed message

Parse this plain Docker log line into JSON with ts, app, pid and message:
2023-10-12 14:05:17 app[4321]: listening on 0.0.0.0:8080

This klog line is an error. Return JSON with level set to error, source, message and err:
E1012 14:05:18.123456   1234 kubelet.go:245] "Pod container health check failed" err="HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 500"
output: {"level": "error", "timestamp": "1012 14:05:18.123456", "pid": 1234, "source": "kubelet.go:245", "message": "Pod container health check failed", "err": "HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 500"}

instruction:
Parse this kubelet stop line into JSON with event, container, pod and node:
Oct 12 14:05:20 ip-10-0-1-5 kubelet[900]: Stopping container api (api-7d9f-abc12) on node ip-10-0-1-5

Parse this containerd log line into JSON with level, msg, id and image:
2023-10-12T14:05:21.123Z level=info msg="starting container" id=abc123 image=registry.example.com/api:v1.2.3
Write a grok pattern that parses a CRI container log line into time, stream, flag and message

Parse this Fluentd style kubernetes log JSON and return the bare log message as JSON:
{"log": "GET /health 200", "stream": "stdout", "time": "2023-10-12T14:05:33.123456789Z", "kubernetes": {"pod_name": "api-7d9f-abc12", "container_name": "app", "namespace": "default"}}

Parse this docker syslog driver line into JSON with time, container and message:
Oct 12 14:05:34 ip-10-0-1-5 docker[1234]: time="2023-10-12T14:05:34Z" level=info container=api message="container healthy"
Write a Python function that extracts the message part of a CRI log line (time, stream, flag, message)
